title: PostReady: PR #509 — Revert #508: save returns to the pack page
description: Reverted PR #508 (save landing on Post Packs list) — save now returns to the pack page as before. Quick course-correction shipped Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #508 — After saving a generated image, land on the Post Packs list
description: UX improvement: after saving a generated image, the user is now redirected to the Post Packs list instead of staying on the current page. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #507 — Replace GPT double hyphens with em dashes in generated copy
description: Copy quality fix: GPT-generated post text now correctly uses em dashes (—) instead of double hyphens (--). Improves readability and typographic polish across all generated content. Merged Jul 14.

title: PostReady: PR #506 — Poll Mux for SDR MP4 (fix HDR swap never firing)
description: Fixed a race condition where the Mux HDR→SDR swap was silently never firing. Switched to polling Mux for the SDR MP4 asset to ensure HDR normalization actually completes before publish. Merged Jul 14.

title: PostReady: PR #505 — Fix Mux HDR swap: drop bogus static_renditions.status check
description: Fixed a bug in the Mux HDR→SDR normalization where a spurious static_renditions.status check was causing incorrect behavior. Dropped the bogus check so HDR-to-SDR swapping works correctly. Merged Jul 14.

title: PostReady: PR #504 — Switch HDR→SDR normalization to Mux (replaces fal serverless)
description: Replaced the fal serverless ffmpeg approach from PR #502 with Mux for HDR→SDR normalization at upload time, improving reliability and platform consistency for iPhone Dolby Vision video uploads. Merged Jul 14.

title: PostReady: PR #502 — Tone-map HDR uploads to SDR at upload time (fal serverless ffmpeg)
description: Fixed washed-out/faded video posts caused by iPhone Dolby Vision HDR uploads. Added HDR→SDR tone-mapping at upload time via fal serverless ffmpeg, so raw HDR is converted before posting to X, Instagram, and TikTok. Merged Jul 13.

title: PostReady: PR #503 — Swap landing wordmark to the rocket lockup
description: Replaced the lightning-bolt ZippityOne wordmark with the new rocket speech-bubble lockup on the landing page. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #501 — Shotstack: render reframed clips at quality:high
description: Upgraded Shotstack renders for reframed video clips to quality:high, improving output fidelity when per-platform crops are applied at publish time. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #499 — Video upload: clear message when clip exceeds 500MB
description: Added a clear user-facing error message when a video upload exceeds the 500MB limit, preventing silent failures and improving the upload UX. Merged Jul 12.
